verdict.line: You lose if you dump your full combo into a charged Granite Shield or facecheck his level-6 Unstoppable Force; you win if you bait the shield first and burst with Blade of the Exile before he resets.

brief.thesis: This matchup sits at 46% over 1,088 games with an even lane rating because neither side has a hard early punish — Malphite's Granite Shield eats a chunk of any burst you throw out cold, and your stun (Ki Burst) stays at rank 1 for most of the early-mid game under the standard skill order. The matchup is decided by sequencing: who breaks shield/cooldowns first, not who all-ins hardest.

theirWindow.what: Without E up to block it, Seismic Shard (Q, 625 range, 8s cd) slows you into a free Ground Slam (E, 400 range, 7s cd) attack-speed shred, and that combo alone wins the exchange since you can't trade autos back at full speed.

yourWindow.what: If you've just landed a poke auto or Q that broke the shield, immediately chain Broken Wings (Q) into Ki Burst (W) and autos before it resets — a full combo into a charged shield wastes most of your burst for nothing.

start.why: 46.4% win rate over 1,098 games at 83.5% pick — the sustained damage and lifesteal matter since Granite Shield means your early trades run longer than a clean burst exchange.

boots.why: 47.3% win rate at 59% pick; the ability haste lowers Broken Wings, Ki Burst, and Valor cooldowns, which is how you re-engage and re-block faster against a laner who out-ranges your dash with Seismic Shard.

core.why: The shield and proc damage help punch through Granite Shield on the all-in and keep you alive through a Ground Slam poke.
Armor shred directly counters the bonus armor Malphite gains from Brutal Strikes (W), and the haste keeps your combo cooldowns short.
Damage-over-time conversion lets you survive extended trades and the delayed magic damage from Ground Slam and Unstoppable Force.

situational.when: malphite's ground slam and r engage are chipping you down and you need magic resist and tenacity over lucidity
you need a defensive magic-resist spike to survive his unstoppable force all-in
you're snowballing lane and want the cooldown reduction on wind slash resets to close it out faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained poke-and-fall-back pattern this matchup demands — you build stacks trading into Granite Shield, then convert them into the burst window once it's down.

summoners.why: 87.6% pick at 46.6% win rate — Ignite secures kills in the all-in before Granite Shield or sustain lets him escape, and Flash gives you a follow-up onto a broken shield or an out against his level-6 Unstoppable Force.

playing.title: Bait the shield before all-in
playing.detail: Granite Shield only recharges if Malphite hasn't been hit recently; land a poke auto or Q first to break it, then dump your full combo before it resets.

playing.title: Use Valor to dodge Seismic Shard
playing.detail: Seismic Shard (Q, 625 range, 8s cd) steals your movement speed; time Valor (E) to block it so you aren't slowed into his follow-up.

playing.title: Respect Ground Slam's attack-speed shred
playing.detail: Ground Slam (E, 400 range, 7s cd) cuts your attack speed, which delays the auto-weaves that spend your Runic Blade charges — don't idle in melee range when it's up.

playing.title: Don't lean on W to lock him down
playing.detail: Under the common skill order, Ki Burst stays at rank 1 from level 3 until level 14, so its stun window is short — plan trades around Q poke and E's damage block, not a long chain-stun.

playing.title: Track Unstoppable Force at level 6
playing.detail: His ultimate (130s cooldown at rank 1, 1000 range) is a knock-up gap-closer; once he hits 6, stop overextending on waves where a flashless engage picks you off.

playing.title: Punish with Blade of the Exile resets
playing.detail: Riven's R grants bonus AD, range, and a one-time Wind Slash; fire it once his shield is broken and Seismic Shard/Ground Slam are both down so he can't answer with Brutal Strikes' armor buff.

playing.title: Play for even, not for a bailout
playing.detail: This sits at 46% over 1,088 games with an even lane rating — don't force all-ins hoping for an edge that isn't there, out-rotate and out-wave instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice above is my own read of the ability kit.

stats.opponentTip: Absorb the damage on Malphite’s (Q) with [E]. Engage Malphite by managing the stacks on Conqueror, and dealing burst damage and falling back. Be careful of enemy (R).
